brief:
Izz al-Din al-Qassam Brigades, the military wing of Hamas, revealed the identity of the operative behind a major compound operation east of Shati refugee camp in northern Gaza, the Shehab Wire reported. The disclosure was made as part of the "Flood Moons" series, a documentation project that chronicles operations during the ongoing conflict in the enclave.

The announcement follows a pattern of the armed group identifying fighters involved in significant attacks against Israeli forces. Details about the specific operation east of the camp and the background of the fighter were not included in the available material. The Shati camp, located in Gaza City, has been a focal point of military operations throughout the conflict.
